$doc: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F12: the App Store screenshot scenes, in listing order. Each names the flags its look depends on. scripts/store-assets-check.mjs (AT-28) fails the submission lane if any of those flags is off in the tree being submitted, if an uploaded screenshot maps to no scene, or if a scene is missing a screenshot. Files are <device>-<n>-<id>.png in fastlane/screenshots/en-US.

scenes.what: The orb's corona following the spoken word on the play screen
A miss: the attempt marked in the answer box, the correct spelling under it, in amber
A perfect run: the orb in totality with sparks
The menu: the modes with their drawn icons
Four languages, four scripts: Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Vietnamese
The earnable themes, Daybreak to Spelling Bee Stage
